cohort: Fifty hospitalized pre-eclamptic pregnant women were assigned to either an experimental group receiving music therapy plus conventional care or a control group receiving conventional care only.
finding: Instrumental soothing music significantly reduced systolic and diastolic blood pressure in pre-eclamptic pregnant women and improved the total well-being of mother and baby.
mod_finding: The experimental group showed a significant reduction in the incidence of caesarean section compared to the control group.
